name: Mohammad Montasim Al Mamun Shuvo
title: Senior Software Engineer | AI-first full-stack | Real-time, AI-driven SaaS | Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript
tagline: Designing, building and shipping scalable products from idea to production.
about:
I started as a junior engineer at MyMedicalHub International, and **4+ years** later I lead a team of **3 engineers** building a HIPAA-compliant platform that **1,000+ patients and clinicians** rely on. I am proudest that **99.9%** of their AI assessment sessions now finish without a crash, and that we got there while cutting our cloud bill by **70%**.

Healthcare is where I work, but it is not the only thing I build. I have also shipped **education**, **fitness**, **customer messaging** and **AI creator** platforms, and **Air Traffic Control**, a small game now on three app stores, often in both English and Bangla because that is how my users speak.

What ties it together is how I like to work: plan for what can go wrong before it does, keep things simple enough for the next person to change, and share what I learn along the way. If you want the details, the **56 case studies** here walk through the decisions behind each project.
